2. The opposite-side fills were small (206 and 13) and landed on its own quotes. Price moved 0.5 tick against the trader, with no reversion and a round trip of 0. Neither core spoofing feature is present.
3. The window has no public events, no risk events and no prior alerts for the trader. The order-to-trade ratio of 22.3 is below the desk-typical 40.

**What would change my mind:** a single order of 3x depth or more, one-sided cancels, or a favourable price move with reversion around the opposite-side fills. I only looked at this window, so a repeated one-sided pattern in other sessions would also change it.
